text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Feng shui...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: It's the study of how the environment affects your relationship with fortune, for good or ill, backed up by solid evidence. And just so we're clear, it's not anything occult.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's a legitimate science based on
evidence
accumulated over the past
3,000 years.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
By using feng shui to perceive the
fortunes of the
surrounding environment
and absorb qi energy...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Anyone can easily find happiness. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, right?! So, what do you say to
taking
your first foray into the world of
feng shui with
me? C'mon, say yes!
Please?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It'll really take your race and test results
to the
next level! There's no doubt in my
mind! ♪

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Hmm... That would be pretty sweet if it was legit.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
But praying at a shrine's probably
enough to do
the job, right? See you
later, Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hold on. This is totally different
from relying
on divine intervention!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Geez... I keep trying, but no one gets it.
All I want
to do is help everyone find
their happiness.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Well, no point in standing around and moping! It looks like there's only one thing to do! Yep, there's only one thing I can do. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Don't you think now's just
about the
perfect time?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I've found a partner in you, I've
completed my
basic training, and on my
way to class this
morning...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
When I was running up the hill from west
to east,
the morning sun looked even
brighter than usual.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: According to landform feng shui—which involves making decisions based on your surroundings—that's a clear sign that I ought to move forward!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So, how about we try it? Y'know, the
Twinkle
Series! Now's the time for us to
put ourselves out
there into the world! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Of course! From the day we met... Since
you and I
made our commitment...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I've been making preparations! Getting
ready for
this exact moment. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the hopes of showing everyone the
power of
feng shui and sharing its
blessings far and wide,
Copano Rickey
sets her sights on the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It may seem a little shady at first glance,
but as
her trainer, I know it's real.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, over there! In that corner! A lot of
trainers
are gathering in one spot. But
why?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's not safe for them to run like
this! You
have to stop the race from
happening!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey sensed the danger
through feng
shui. And her concerns
were proven exactly right.
On top of
that...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(I can see it... I can feel it... The flow of
qi! The
earth's voice is telling me what's
happening on
the track!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(The final straight! The landform and the
compass
are all in order. Luck is on my
side. From here
on...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The fastest wins! Now to direct all the
effort I've
put in to the lucky direction!
YAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through the power of feng shui, she
predicted
what was going to happen
during the race, and
ran incredibly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey's feng shui is the real
deal. And...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want to win! I want to do great in the
Twinkle
Series and make people believe
in the power of
feng shui...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And I want to make everyone happy. ☆
Just like
how feng shui made me happy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I run into a problem or when
my life
takes a new direction, it gives me
just enough
courage to face things
head-on. Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's what feng shui's about! ☆ Anyone
can be
happy if they just know how to
seize their chance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey's motivation for running
is simple.
She wants to spread the
wisdom of feng shui
through her races
and make everyone happy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's more than enough reason to
support her.
She's a runner I want to
help get up to the top, no
matter what.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Trainer? Are you going to
give me
the go-ahead?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yayyy! Then from here on out, I'll work
hard to
change people's perceptions of
feng shui. Little
by little, step by step.
choice_data_list: もちろん！今日から頑張ろう！

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run in real races and show
them just
how amazing the power of
feng shui can be. ☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Rickey. I heard that you've decided
to make
your debut?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If the rumors are true, then
congratulations.
There's something I
want to talk to you about
first, though...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Are you going to specialize in dirt races?
I
remember hearing you were better
suited to dirt
than turf.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oohoo, things are sure to get lively if
Rickey joins
us.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh, Tarumae! Acute!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep, you betcha. I'm going to go all out
on the
dirt. ☆ At first, anyway. I mean...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Dirt's the best for feng shui! ♪ All that
sand
scattering about gives shape to
both the state of
the environment and
everyone's ambitions.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oop... Feng shui... There you go again
with all
that pie-in-the-sky talk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is Hokko Tarumae. She's in the year
above
Copano Rickey and races to
promote her
hometown of Tomakomai,
where she's a local
idol.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, but I'd say it's nice that she's got
a hobby
she's so passionate about. Don't
you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And this is Wonder Acute. She's a real
dirt track
veteran and tends to speak in
a grandmotherly
fashion.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm all about you giving it your absolute
best. I
just don't want you getting
caught up in
superstitions...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: And I'm just hoping we can all have a nice, friendly race together.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're just like a granddaughter to me,
Rickey.
That's why I'm going to give you
plenty of
encouraging little pats on the
head.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, c'mon, you two. I'm serious about
putting my
best foot forward in every
race, you know.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But I guess you might not believe in the
power of
feng shui until you actually see
it in action.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's right. She might not be able to
convince
them with words alone. In that
case...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Just like you believe in me,
Trainer, I'm sure
that someday everyone
else will too!
choice_data_list: レースで証明しよう、リッキー！
レースで証明しようよ、リッキー！

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's do this! I'm going to
spread the
teachings of feng shui by
running, and make
everyone happy for
sure!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆ Super happy!
